1306-5660-6769-6798.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1306-5660-6769-6798.description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mana Crypt, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1385-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1385-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

151-5261-7290.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-5261-7290.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-5261-7290.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Does Machines.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

2349-2724-8172.description:
Activate Mistmeadow Witch by paying {2}{W}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

512-4644-5457.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-4644-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
512-4644-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4644-5457.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1453-2511-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2511-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-5671-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-5671-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4247-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

824-2511-2728-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2511-2728-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2511-2728-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

275-3536-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

792-1263-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1117-2866-6518-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1117-2866-6518-7693.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-4772-5147-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

290-1978-7329.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3200-7220.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Glamermite.
When Glamermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3967-7084-7201.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1526-1781-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
1526-1781-1978.description:
Cause Circle of Dreams Druid to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-5268-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

225-1170-1645-5954-6751.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1645-5954-6751.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3147-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-6662.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

813-2103-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Siren's Ruse.
813-2103-2417.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-2457-3129-4885.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1621-3991.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-1621-3991.notablePrerequisites: Wispweaver Angel exiled by Faceless Butcher
372-1621-3991.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Faceless Butcher and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Wispweaver Angel from exile to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Faceless Butcher to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Faceless Butcher and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Faceless Butcher and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2719-2921-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2719-2921-5365.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2719-2921-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

586-2146-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

509-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Idris does not have summoning sickness.
509-4131-4893.description:
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
